title: Desire Layer — Premium Product Polish
summary: YTIntel now feels more like a premium creator intelligence product: clearer value, stronger hierarchy, better decision states, richer empty states and a more desirable Smart Start experience.
discord_changes: Rebuilt Smart Start around the outcome: find the signal, prove it and leave with a production-ready next move.
Added clearer workflow rails, stronger score presentation and next-best-action prompts across Radar, Research Sprint, Packaging Lab and Creator Loop.
Added premium visual polish, stronger empty states and restrained motion so the product feels faster, clearer and more valuable without weakening evidence guardrails.
changes: Smart Start is now the real hero instead of sitting beneath a duplicate introductory section.
The primary Smart Start message is now outcome-led: find the signal, prove it and ship the video.
Added a four-part product value strip covering Discover, Validate, Package and Learn.
Added a compact trust rail for channel-relative baselines, winner-vs-control reasoning, cross-channel validation and originality guardrails.
Added screen-level workflow rails to Opportunity Radar, Research Sprint, Packaging Lab and Creator Loop so each area explains its job immediately.
Opportunity scores now render like decision instruments rather than plain dashboard numbers, while still avoiding guaranteed-performance claims.
Packaging results now visually prioritise the strongest test candidate without presenting the score as a promise of views.
Added next-best-action bars that push research into validation, packaging into execution and ready briefs into Creator Loop tracking.
Reworked Radar and Packaging empty states so zero-data screens explain what will unlock and give a useful next action.
Added subtle scan, loading and pulse motion with reduced-motion support for accessibility.
Strengthened active navigation, card hierarchy, spacing, hover feedback, primary actions and a restrained YTIntel signal-red brand accent.
Kept the v0.18.1 Radar scoring, workflow reliability fixes, evidence gates and originality protections intact.
why_it_matters: YTIntel already had increasingly strong research mechanics, but powerful software still loses users when the interface feels like a collection of tools. This release makes the product communicate value faster, makes the next action more obvious, and makes important intelligence feel important while preserving the evidence-first guardrails underneath it.
